sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong and will be heavy favourites against bottom-dwellers Alsager, who have won just once all season. They then face Cheadle Heath Nomads away on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00) in what should be another winnable fixture against a team struggling near the foot of the table.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, while the chasing pack includes in-form Wolverhampton Casuals and AFC Bridgnorth, both with 19 points. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday 3 October looking to maintain momentum. AFC Bridgnorth host fellow mid-table side Eccleshall in what could be a significant clash. The bottom end of the table remains competitive: Widnes Town (2 points) visit Brereton Social, Alsager Town travel to Sandbach, and Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town—all fixtures involving teams fighting to avoid the drop. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host Foley Meir, while Crewe welcome Allscott Heath and Market Drayton Town face New Mills on 3 October. Shawbury United, on a concerning run of six consecutive losses, host Barnton away on 10 October. The midweek fixture sees Brereton Social entertain Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45). Other notable Saturday 10 October matches include Bilston Town v Crewe, Stafford Town v Wednesfield Community, and Telford Town v New Mills.
